verdict.rationale: The evidence covers on-ramp purchases (users buying crypto, with their wallet address pre-filled), a widget-driven off-ramp to bank or card, and an enterprise feature that converts incoming fiat into stablecoins. None of these is a developer-initiated API payout of stablecoins to a wallet address or stored recipient. The webhook docs give transaction status updates in general, but nothing documents a payout endpoint or settlement tracking for payouts, so they are adjacent features that earn no credit here.
